json_patch.value: Fix: docs(client): correct token endpoint TLS citation. Target files: .changeset/correct-token-endpoint-tls-citation.md, packages/client/src/client/auth.ts, packages/client/src/client/authErrors.ts. The JSDoc for `assertSecureTokenEndpoint` and `InsecureTokenEndpointError` attributed the token-endpoint TLS check to SEP-2207, which covers OIDC-flavored refresh-token guidance. This change points the explanation to the MCP authorization specification's HTTPS requirement and describes the SDK's loopback exemption ... (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/2768)
